question.text: Which of the following statements about the Merchant Banker appointed for filing the PPM of Satpura Market-Neutral Fund is CORRECT?

answer.text: The Merchant Banker shall NOT be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee.
The Merchant Banker may be an associate of the AIF's Sponsor to ensure cost efficiency.
The Merchant Banker is appointed only once at registration and is not required for subsequent PPM changes.
The Merchant Banker is chosen by SEBI from an empanelled list and the AIF has no say.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9.7.1 explicitly says: 'The Merchant Banker appointed for filing of placement memorandum shall not be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee.' This protects arm's-length due diligence. The Trap: Option B inverts the rule. Option C misses that CHANGES to the PPM also have to be intimated through a Merchant Banker on a consolidated basis within 1 month of each FY end. Option D is fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers merchant-banker independence across tracks. XIX-B may test this via a conflict-of-interest scenario for distributors. Manager's Pro-Tip: Panel-test 2-3 Merchant Bankers with AIF expertise before onboarding — Chapter 9.7.1 requires credentials and track record. A weak MB means SEBI observations cycle gets drawn out and launch date slips.
